job.title: Cybersecurity Engineer, Mobile & AI Application
job.pay_full: $118,700 – $183,600 a year (estimated salary range), may be eligible for bonus and equity

details.about: Visa's Mobile & Mac Security (MMS) team, part of its Cybersecurity department, works like a small, fast-paced startup inside the company and uses white-hat hacking skills to keep Visa's mobile and Mac consumer and corporate products secure. The team wants someone highly proficient with AI tools who also understands how they work, including MCP and other AI protocols, with experience of both cloud and local LLMs. Local candidates are preferred.
duties: Develop, maintain and improve the team's internal cybersecurity tools
Run ethical penetration tests on Visa's mobile and Mac assets
Find weaknesses in products' security posture and recommend stronger controls
Create mobile security guidelines, requirements and standards for product development and enterprise mobile deployment
Use AI to create and improve the team's processes, and implement solutions on internal cloud platforms
Build tools, frameworks, automated scripts and foundational application security capabilities
Research new mobile platform releases to set security standards
Bring architectural risk assessment and threat modelling into the software development lifecycle
Improve secure coding practices, security requirements, automation, training and metrics, working with product and development teams
needs: 2+ years of relevant work experience and a Bachelor's degree, or 5+ years of relevant work experience (Master's graduates need 2+ years)
Strong experience with one or more of Node, Python, Java or Swift
Understanding of current AI technologies, protocols and AI development tooling
Understanding of the OWASP Top 10 and CWE 25, with a track record of implementing remediation
Understanding of mobile application and platform security concepts
nice: 3+ years of work experience with a Bachelor's, or 2+ years with an advanced degree
Strong Docker and containerized deployment experience
Deep mobile platform knowledge, including SDKs and mobile wallets
Strong penetration testing and application risk assessment skills (reverse engineering, network interception, injection attacks)
Tools such as Burp Suite, IDA Pro, APKTool, Hopper, HP Fortify, Checkmarx, Cycript, Xposed, Charles, dex2jar, Kali Linux or Wireshark
Agile development and secure development practices; strong communication; bi- or multilingual a plus
details.benefits: Estimated salary range for the US: $118,700 – $183,600 a year, which may include potential sales incentive payments; pay depends on knowledge, skills, experience and location. The role may be eligible for bonus and equity. Visa's benefits package may include medical, dental, vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, life insurance, paid time off and a wellness program.
notes: Hybrid: days in the office are confirmed by the hiring manager
Work hours vary with the needs of the department
